name: @cyanmycelium/mcp-broker-workspace
description: npm workspace root for the CyanMycelium MCP broker and its client-side tunnel transports.
author: Guillaume Pelletier (CyanMycelium)

scripts.//build: Dependency order, not folder order: `npm run --workspaces` walks packages alphabetically, and the broker compiles against the provider's published dist. Add new packages here, downstream last.
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @cyanmycelium/mcp-broker-provider && npm run build --workspace @cyanmycelium/mcp-broker
